name: Apple Jack | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Reload)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE 
Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market. 
Apple Jack is a Jack-of-all-trades kinda strain. Delivering a mix of head and body effects, with a relaxing physical high balanced by a euphoric cerebral sensation, this sour apple tasting strain is great for those who want to get creative and relieve stress. 
Apple 
Citrus 
Tangy
